title: Replace one costly raw disclosure using two calibrated noisy records
statement: For the specified N1073 rational K,L,two iid records at the same X suffice with zero raw:if c counts zeros,emit0 with probabilities(13/25,17/100,0) at c=0,1,2,otherwise split1,2 equally. g(p)=13/25-(7/10)p+(9/50)p^2 gives the exact K at p=2/3,1/6. Ordinary classifier/garbling ties the two-call budget.

requires: The actual specified point-calibrated source K,L
Two fresh conditionally iid calls at the same persistent classical X
Unbiased private random bits and corrected typed-callback boundary
provides: Exact single K output,no raw read,exactly two cheap calls
assumptions: Only Y leaves the module;private proxy records,degree,count,flags,raw values and memory are discarded.
An already-classical X persists throughout the block;coherent input or state-changing detector access is not acquired.
Not robust exactness for an open unknown calibration neighborhood
The previous one-call minimax3/40 remains valid at its one-call interface
Do not reuse one block as independent K outputs
costs: Charge every actual cheap/raw disclosure,calibration,preparation/reset,input lifetime,entropy,storage,latency and arithmetic. Equally informed ordinary classifiers,factories,common-part splitting and one-read caching receive the same resources. No measured complete-resource advantage.
